==English==
[[File:Hohenzollern Haus Wappen.svg|thumb|150px|A '''quarterly''' coat of arms (Hohenzollern)]]

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-quarterly.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Etymology 1===
{{ety|en|:af|quarter<id:fourth>|-ly<pos:adjectival><id:adjectival>|text=+|tree=1}}

====Adjective====
{{en-adj|-}}

# Occurring once every [[quarter]] year (three months); taking place [[quarter-yearly]].
#: {{ux|en|'''quarterly''' rent payments}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Priya Krishnakumar|title=Murders rose sharply in 2020 but data is lacking across much of the country|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/27/politics/uniform-crime-report-2020/index.html|date=2021-09-27|passage=The FBI began publishing national '''quarterly''' crime reports last year, but has not done so for the first two quarters of 2021, stating that they require at least 60% of agencies to submit NIBRS data in order to publish '''quarterly''' data.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220224194911/https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/27/politics/uniform-crime-report-2020/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|heraldry}} (of a [[coat of arms]]) Divided into four parts crosswise.
#: {{ux|en|The arms of Hohenzollern is '''quarterly''' argent and sable.}}
